description: Put several charts, maps or KPI cards and some text into one report. Returns a link to a report page (shareable, PDF download) and a PowerPoint deck with a slide per chart. Each chart block takes the same fields as the matching generate_* tool, plus its 'type' (e.g. column, line, pie, country-map, world-map, county-map, kpi). Each call makes a new report; to update the same report link later use create_living_chart with type 'report'. Returns the report, PDF, PowerPoint and chart image links.

blocks.description: In order: headings, paragraphs and charts (at most 12 charts).

subtitle.description: Line under the title, e.g. the period covered.

name: create_report
title: Report from several charts
